underlying_release: Tencent RapidJSON v1.1.0-763-g24b5e7a8 (vendored headers in the python-rapidjson sdist; SAX Reader with kParseNumbersAsStringsFlag and kParseNanAndInfFlag under the default number_mode)
build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist with clang/clang++ -O0 and LLVM source coverage. The official aarch64 cp311 wheel compiles the same rapidjson.cpp and vendored headers into one optimised extension; compiler flags and optimisation differ.
api: rapidjson.load(io.BytesIO(local JSON bytes)); rapidjson.loads(bytes) and rapidjson.loads(decoded str) are checked against the same oracle
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-region coverage of the source-built python-rapidjson extension: wrapper rapidjson.cpp (stream wrapper and PyHandler) and the vendored Tencent RapidJSON C++ headers instantiated by it
scope: JSON structure and values from a local BytesIO stream via rapidjson.load; valid nested object and nested array controls only, each matching an exact type-tagged CPython json oracle tree
